title: feat(console): the sharing-rule object picker lists only shareable objects, business objects first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBy2QatVq72fKr8HLn4oAbE)_

Fixes #31217

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新建共享规则时,「对象」下拉框改为只列「规则存得进、也能生效」的对象,业务对象在前、平台对象在后,顺序照服务器 `GET /api/v1/sharing/shareable-objects` 给的原样显示。新增字段控件 `shareable-object-ref`,`sys_sharing_rule.object_name` 的控件提示从 `object-ref` 改为它(同一个 PR 注册、同一个 PR 切换)。
- 为什么改:原来下拉框列出全部 86 个对象,多数是 `sys_*`,还包括存了会被 `SHARING_NOT_ENABLED` 拒绝的对象和会话、凭据类对象;#30209 第 5 行方案 B 的控制台半边,服务器半边 PR #31207 已合并。
- 风险与回滚:接口答 403(不是共享规则管理员)、501(本部署没跑共享规则)或任何读不出列表的情况,字段退回原来的 `object-ref` 全量列表,不会出现空下拉框;保存时服务器仍是最终裁决。已存的规则对象不在列表里时仍保留为选项,编辑不会丢值。列表格子和只读面沿用 `object-ref` 的对象名标签。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/ShareableObjectRefField.tsx`(读接口与退回逻辑),`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormShareableObjectRef-31217.test.tsx`(在新建表单上点选、保存、403/501 退回),`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-sharing-rule.object.ts`(控件提示)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormShareableObjectRef-31217.test.tsx`,预期 `Tests 5 passed (5)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The widget** (`@object-ui/fields`, new `widgets/ShareableObjectRefField.tsx`, registered as `field:shareable-object-ref`). It reads `GET /api/v1/sharing/shareable-objects` through the host's authenticated fetch (`SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch`, the route the `notification-topic` picker reads its door by) and offers `data.objects` in the order the door sends: business objects, then platform objects, each by label. Options use `objectRefOptionLabel`, the `Label (name)` spelling `object-ref` uses, and a pick writes the object's machine name. A stored name the list does not hold is kept as its own leading option, so editing a rule on an object that no longer takes one never drops the value. No new translation key: the loading, placeholder, search and empty strings are `object-ref`'s.
- **The fallback.** When the door does not answer a readable list, the field renders `ObjectRefField` unchanged: every registered object from `dataSource.getObjects()`. That covers the two states the card names, `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (not a sharing-rule administrator) and `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (sharing rules not running), and also any other non-2xx, a body that is not the door's shape, a network failure, and a host with no `apiFetch`. Never an empty picker. The read-only face is also `object-ref`'s, so a record page does not call an admin-only door.
- **The declaration** (`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`). `sys_sharing_rule.object_name` declares `widget: 'shareable-object-ref'`, flipped in the PR that registers the widget. The `by_object` pin moves with it, and the census of fields that store an object API name (`sys-sharing-rule.by-object.test.ts`) counts the new widget beside `object-ref`, so the no-grouping rule still reaches this field.
- **The other faces of the key**, each the row `object-ref` already has: the list cell promotes to the same object label face (`WIDGET_CELL_RENDERER_TYPES`, the default text face in `@object-ui/fields` and the console's `ObjectRefCell` in `@object-ui/app-shell`); the record form threads `dataSource` to it (`DATA_SOURCE_ONLY_WIDGET_TYPES` in `@object-ui/components`, which the fallback reads); it is not edited inline in a grid (`FieldEditWidget`); it is a widget-hint-only string in `paramValueShape`; and `field:shareable-object-ref` joins the known schema types of `@object-ui/cli`.
- **Registry censuses** that enumerate every registered widget gain the row: `widget-aria-invalid-registry-e2e`, `widget-dom-leak-e2e`, `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596`, `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464` (fit side 41 to 42), `inlineEditTypeCoverage`, and the `className` readers in `form-field-channel-census-12130`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31217-shareable-object-picker.md`, patch on the five shipping packages, both declaration lines.

### Declaration lines, as measured

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. The claim started at `no`; the diff adds a registered widget key, which widens the published `RegisteredFieldWidgetType` union of `@object-ui/fields` and the known schema types of `@object-ui/cli` (the precedent is `.changeset/31062-notification-topic-channel-pickers.md`). No translation key is added, removed or reworded; no export is added (the widget is reached only through the lazy registry, not the package barrel); nothing is narrowed.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. The spec's `FieldSchema.widget` is an open string, so no authorable key or accepted value changes. The flip changes the value one server object declares, which only picks the console control.

## Tests

- New `objectFormShareableObjectRef-31217.test.tsx` drives `ObjectForm` in create mode inside `SchemaRendererProvider` (as the console mounts it), opening the real combobox and submitting the real form: (1) the door's list in its order and nothing else (no `sys_session`, no `sys_api_key`, no object the door leaves out), the registry list never read; (2) CONTROL: a shareable object is selectable and the form saves `object_name: 'crm_opportunity'`; (3) a stored name the door does not list stays an option; (4, 5) a 403 and a 501 give the `object-ref` list of every registered object, and a pick from it saves.
- Ablations on the final head, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit, restore proved by blob equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`): ignoring the door's list (`objects: null`) reds tests 1 and 3; answering a refused door with an empty list (`return []`) reds tests 4 and 5.

## Acceptance notes

- The door withholds localization (its header: "the list is the same in every language"), so the picker shows the labels the server declares. `object-ref`'s list (`GET /meta/object`) carries declared labels too, so no language loses a translation here.
- A failure other than 403/501 also falls back rather than showing a notice. The save doors stay the authority (`SHARING_NOT_ENABLED`), so the wider list costs a refusal at save, never a wrong rule, and adding a notice would add translation keys this card did not ask for.

## Verification

Head `309f44a0`; every count below is read off the tool's own verdict line.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `packages/fields/`, `packages/plugin-form/`, `packages/components/src/renderers/form/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/widget-ref-cells/`, `packages/app-shell/src/utils/`, `packages/cli/src/__tests__/` and the census files above (under `os-verify-lock`): `Test Files 696 passed | 2 skipped`, with 6 census files red on the first run, each the missing row for the new key; after adding the rows the 7 touched files pass, `Tests 456 passed (456)`, re-run on `309f44a0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: `Test Files 70 passed (70)`, `Tests 1464 passed (1464)`.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `309f44a0`: 67 derived families, all 67 run with exit 0 (codes captured before any pipe); `--ran`: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The branch merges cleanly onto `origin/main` `abc7a940` (`git merge-tree`). `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
